definition_zh: 持有人；持有者；支架；托架；夹具
definition_en: a person who owns or has something such as a ticket or a title, or an object used to hold something in place
core_image: 握住不放的手：证件、头衔被握在手里，笔被卡在托架上
scene: 图书馆的借阅台上，管理员把卡片递还给他，说了一句。The library clerk handed back the card and said, "Show it to the holder at the front desk."
sceneCN: 这里 holder 是「持有人」（第 1 个义项：合法持有某物的人）；句意是管理员让他把卡片出示给前台那位持有它的人，核心画面是把东西握在手里的人。

pos.zh: 持有人；持有者（证件、头衔、职务等）
支架；托架；夹具（固定物品的器具）

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，握住；持有；容纳，holder 由它加施动者后缀构成
hold 加 -ing 构成，义为「持有；持有的股份或产业」
house 与 hold 复合，义为「家庭；一家人」
古英语复合词，义为「门槛；起点」，词源与 hold 无关

senses.title: A person who legally has something
senses.definition: a person who owns, possesses, or officially has something such as a ticket, a card, or an account
senses.definitionCN: 合法拥有或持有票证、卡片、账户等东西的人
senses.example: Ticket holders should arrive thirty minutes early.
senses.exampleCN: 持票人应提前三十分钟到场。
senses.why: The verb hold means to keep something in your hands, so a holder is simply the person on the other side of that hand.
senses.whyCN: 动词 hold 表示「握住」，holder 就是「握着它的人」，从手上的动作落到人的身份上。

senses.title: A person who holds a title, record, or position
senses.definition: a person who has a title, a record, an office, or a position
senses.definitionCN: 拥有头衔、保持纪录或担任某一职务的人
senses.example: She is the world record holder in the marathon.
senses.exampleCN: 她是马拉松世界纪录保持者。
senses.why: A title or record is imagined as something grasped and not let go, so the person keeping it is the holder.
senses.whyCN: 头衔和纪录被想象成「握在手里不放」的东西，谁握着谁就是 holder。

senses.title: An object used to hold something in place
senses.definition: a device or container designed to keep an object steady or in position
senses.definitionCN: 用来固定或安放物品的器具，使其稳定不动
senses.example: There is a cup holder beside each seat in the car.
senses.exampleCN: 车内每个座位旁边都有一个杯架。
senses.why: The core image of holding extends from people to tools: the device literally holds the object for you.
senses.whyCN: 「握住」的意象从人扩展到器具：这种装置替你「握住」物品，于是也叫 holder。

intro.en: Holder is a transparent English formation: the verb hold plus the agent suffix -er.
intro.cn: holder 是一个构成透明的英语词：动词 hold 加上表「人／物」的后缀 -er。

items.en: The verb goes back to the reconstructed Proto-Germanic root *haldan or *huldan, meaning to keep or to grasp.
items.cn: 动词可追溯至重构的原始日耳曼语词根 *haldan／*huldan，意为「保存；抓住」。

items.en: In Old English it appears as healdan, meaning to contain, to keep, or to guard.
items.cn: 古英语写作 healdan，表示「容纳；保有；守护」。

items.en: The verb settles as holden, and the agent noun holder emerges with the -er suffix.
items.cn: 中古英语定型为 holden，带 -er 后缀的施动名词 holder 随之出现。

items.en: The personal sense, one who has a title or a document, becomes common in legal and commercial writing.
items.cn: 表示「持有文件、头衔之人」的用法在十六至十七世纪的法律与商业文书中普及。

items.en: The object sense, a device that holds something, spreads with everyday inventions such as pen holders and match holders.
items.cn: 十九世纪随笔架、火柴座等日常小物件的普及，「固定物品的器具」一义广泛使用。

items.en: Today holder freely combines with other nouns: ticket holder, account holder, cup holder.
items.cn: 如今 holder 可自由与名词组合：ticket holder 持票人、account holder 账户持有人、cup holder 杯架。

note.en: Holder looks plain, but it hides two near neighbours with different suffixes and a small family of look-alikes.
note.cn: holder 看似简单，但它有两个后缀相近的邻居，还有一小群拼写相像的词。

senses.definitionCN: 邀请并接待客人的人
senses.example: The host welcomed every guest warmly tonight.
senses.exampleCN: 今晚的主人热情地欢迎每一位客人。
senses.why: This is the oldest and most basic sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老也最基本的义项。

senses.title: An organizer or presenter
senses.definition: a person or group that organizes and leads an event
senses.definitionCN: 组织并主持活动的人或团体
senses.example: She was the host of the evening show.
senses.exampleCN: 她是晚间节目的主持人。
senses.why: Here the word moves from private hospitality to public events.
senses.whyCN: 这里从私人待客转向公开活动。

senses.title: An organism carrying a guest
senses.definition: a living thing or computer that carries another
senses.definitionCN: 承载他者的生物体或计算机
senses.example: The virus needs a host to survive.
senses.exampleCN: 病毒需要宿主才能存活。
senses.why: This scientific sense keeps the idea of providing shelter.
senses.whyCN: 这一科学义项保留了提供居所的意思。

definition_en: having a high temperature, or very popular and in demand
core_image: 一杯冒着热气的汤放在桌上，窗外阳光炽热
scene: 这碗汤太烫了，先放凉一会儿。This bowl of soup is too hot, so let it cool for a while.
sceneCN: 这里 hot 是「热的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这碗汤太烫了，先放凉一会儿。

senses.title: High in temperature
senses.definition: having a high temperature
senses.definitionCN: 温度高的
senses.example: This bowl of soup is too hot, so let it cool for a while.
senses.exampleCN: 这碗汤太烫了，先放凉一会儿。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Spicy to the taste
senses.definition: producing a burning taste in the mouth
senses.definitionCN: 入口产生灼烧感的
senses.example: This chili sauce is too hot for me.
senses.exampleCN: 这种辣椒酱对我来说太辣了。
senses.why: Burning heat on the tongue extends the physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 舌头上的灼热感延伸了物理义项。

senses.title: Popular and in demand
senses.definition: very popular and much sought after
senses.definitionCN: 非常受欢迎、供不应求的
senses.example: The new phone is a hot item this season.
senses.exampleCN: 这款新手机是本季的热门商品。
senses.why: Social heat borrows the image of physical heat.
senses.whyCN: 社会层面的热度借用了物理热度的意象。
